wrc7.title: WRC 7 live pacenotes
wrc7.privilegeWarning: Run ZTMZ and WRC 7 at the same Windows privilege level, preferably both as a normal user.
wrc7.limitations: Experimental single-player support for the verified Windows build. Original game speech remains enabled. Vehicle physics telemetry, synchronized countdown and final results are not yet supported. Calls with unresolved voice-mode or token mapping are left to the original co-driver.
wrc7.warning: This experimental feature injects a DLL into WRC 7 and may affect game stability. Use offline. It remains loaded until the game exits. Continue?
wrc7.windowsOnly: The WRC 7 live bridge currently supports Windows only.
